files.name: dochi_minigames-0.1.3-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.3 Change Log

  • Added dedicated crafting recipes for each game table and separated them into distinct Creative Mode items.
  • Added 12 built-in AI opponents across different factions, with DRM NPC dialogue and battle integration.
  • Added an NPC battle preparation screen and support for Custom, Preset, and Fixed Deck policies.
  • Added 6 faction-themed BGM tracks with in-game playback, stop, and volume controls.
  • Improved editor lists, reward management, asset UI, and fixed various display issues.
  • Dochi's Minigames now runs completely standalone. DRM is no longer required and only provides optional integration features.
